certificates.title: Hlola isitifiketi
certificates.text: Lahla isitifiketi esilondolozwe ku-Mayelana nale mpendulo, ubufakazi baso, noma kokubili, nanoma yiliphi ifayela esingalibiza. Noma ulahle isithombe, ifilimu noma idokhumenti ukuze ufunde ukuthi kwenziwe kanjani. Akukho okunikezayo okuphuma kuleli khasi.
certificates.unreadable: Lokhu akusona isitifiketi sempendulo, ubufakazi baso, noma ifayela elisho ukuthi lenziwe kanjani.
certificates.broken: Kushintshiwe, noma akubekwanga uphawu ngokhiye okubizayo
certificates.credentials: Ifayela {name} linerekhodi elisayiniwe lokuthi lenziwe kanjani, elingashintshile selokhu
certificates.credentialsBroken: Ifayela {name} linerekhodi lokuthi lenziwe kanjani elingemi: lishintshile selokhu, noma alisayinwanga ngokhiye elilibizayo
certificates.unbound: Ukuthi ifayela lishintshile selokhu akuhlolwa lapha
certificates.noRecord: Ifayela {name} alinalo irekhodi lokuthi lenziwe kanjani
certificates.marks: Ifayela {name} lisho ukuthi lenziwe kanjani, lingasayiniwe: noma ubani ubengakubhala
certificates.watermark.match: Uphawu lwalo olungabonakali yilona olubizwa yileli rekhodi
certificates.watermark.other: Uphawu lwalo olungabonakali akulona olubizwa yileli rekhodi
certificates.watermark.fetch: Ukuze kufunwe uphawu olungabonakali, leli khasi liqala ngokulanda isifundi salo kusuka kusayithi {host}, bese lisigcina kulesi siphequluli
certificates.words: Noma unamathisele amagama ukuze ufune uphawu lwengqondo esekudivayisi
certificates.words.marked: La magama anophawu lwengqondo esekudivayisi: iwabhalile, noma othile wawenza abukeke kanjalo
certificates.words.none: Alukho uphawu lwengqondo esekudivayisi olutholakele kula magama, okungafakazeli ukuthi ayiwabhalanga
certificates.words.short: Amagama mancane kakhulu ukuthi kungashiwo: namathisela cishe ikhasi
certificates.words.fetch: Ukuze kufunwe uphawu emagameni, leli khasi liqala ngokulanda isifundi salo kusuka kusayithi {host}, bese lisigcina kulesi siphequluli
certificates.log.fetch: Ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi irejista yomphakathi iyakuqinisekisa, leli khasi liqala ngokulanda ukhiye werejista kusuka kusayithi {host}
certificates.failed: Akukho okukwazile ukulandwa: {host}. Zama futhi kamuva.
certificates.trust.unchecked: Kuqinisekiswe yisiphathimandla inhlangano yakho esithembayo, ngaphandle kobufakazi bokuthi asihoxiswanga
certificates.trust.revoked: Isitifiketi saso sahoxiswa ngaphambi kokuthi lokhu kubekwe uphawu
certificates.fromIntact: Inguqulo {n} yeqoqo, ivaliwe futhi ayishintshanga kusukela lapho
certificates.fromBroken: Inguqulo {n} yeqoqo, ishintshiwe noma ayivalwanga ngokhiye eyibalayo
certificates.fromLive: Imigqa yeqoqo njengoba yayinjalo ngaleso sikhathi, engagcinwa yinguqulo
